title: 第26章 散修和宗门弟子差距！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
距离灵农坊不远的东边是临荒坊，过了临荒坊就到城外蛮荒了。

    “走，咱们去灵田管理处，那里安全。”

    听闻搞不定，巷子里的人没有犹豫，即便是卫家兄弟，都跟着朝着灵田管理处跑去。

    开什么玩笑，妖兽开启灵智修行妖法妖功，实力比蛮兽强的多。

    同境圣宗弟子都难挡，更何况是他们这群住在灵农坊的散修。

    唯有宋达闻言目光闪烁。

    儿子刚入圣宗，要转修呼吸法，欠下了一大笔贡献。

    走着走着，他一咬牙，掉头朝着战斗的方向奔去。

    “你们先走，我去看看。”

    宋达有不少考量，这是圣城，一尊养体境的妖兽翻不起风浪。

    若在杀妖中起到作用，则会被圣宗奖励，他是养体后期，有希望。

    回家抄起灵锄，朝着临荒坊冲去。

    声音便是从那边传来。

    “宋达真糊涂，种了十几年田，战力还剩下几分。”卫家兄弟直摇头。

    一行人跑的更快了，走出巷子再来到街上，浩浩荡荡的人流汇聚在一起。

    足足几千人，逐渐被冲开，不过都在朝着灵田管理处汇聚。

    沈云带着苏婉儿也放松了，一个养体八重的妖兽，怎么也不可能杀到这里。

    杀到这里他们一群人一口唾沫，也能淹死它。

    “快看，那虎妖到街上了，足足有三米多高！”

    从管理处方向居高临下向下望去，能看到街道上一尊黑色的虎妖辗转腾挪，正在大杀四方。

    数个围绕它的血色身影个个散发着强大的气息，却都难对黑虎造成实质伤害。

    反而一个个被虎妖拍飞。

    “同是养体后期，差距这么大吗？”

    第一次见人与妖之间的战斗，沈云也很不解。

    这与他想象的围杀虎妖不同，几乎没有一合之敌。

    “养体后期，一个个气血都逸散体外，功法都没练到家，怎么能发挥出最强的实力。”

    “真正有实力的修士谁住灵农坊和最边缘的临荒坊？都是咱们这些修行入宗无望的散修罢了！”

    “看看那尊黑虎，猛扑横扫间身上浮现血色纹路，没有气血逸散....”

    周围这么多人，自有懂的人七嘴八舌的解释。

    沈云恍然，原来养体后期血气逸散外边看起来很神武，实际上是功法修行不到家的缘故！

    他还以为气血透体，宛若血色游龙本以为是强大的象征。

    “让一让....”

    后方突然传出嘈杂声，有几个外门弟子在疏散人群。

    “罗师兄出来了，快闪开让罗师兄出手！”
content_en:
Not far from Linhuangfang to the east is Linhuangfang. After Linhuangfang, you will reach the wilderness outside the city.

    "Let's go to the Lingtian Management Office. It's safe there."

    Hearing that it could not be done, the people in the alley did not hesitate, even the Wei brothers, they all ran towards the Lingtian Management Office.

    Are you kidding me? The demonic beast activates its spiritual wisdom and practices demonic magic and demonic skills, and its strength is much stronger than that of the savage beast.

    It was difficult for the disciples of the Holy Sect in the same realm to stop him, let alone their group of casual cultivators living in Lingnongfang.

    Only Song Da’s eyes flickered when he heard this.

    My son had just joined the Holy Sect and wanted to switch to the breathing method, so he owed a large contribution.

    As he walked, he gritted his teeth, turned around and ran towards the direction of the battle.

    "You go first, I'll go take a look."

    Song Da had many considerations. This was a holy city, and a monster in the body-nurturing realm could not make trouble.

    If he plays a role in killing demons, he will be rewarded by the Holy Sect. He is in the late stage of body cultivation and has hope.

    He went home, picked up the spiritual hoe, and rushed towards Linhuangfang.

    That's where the sound came from.

    "Song Da is really confused. He has been farming for more than ten years and still has some fighting power left." The Wei brothers shook their heads.

    The group of people ran faster. They walked out of the alley and onto the street, where a huge crowd of people gathered together.

    Thousands of people were gradually rushed away, but they were all converging towards the Lingtian Management Office.

    Chen Yun and Su Wan'er also relaxed. It was impossible for an eighth-level monster to kill here.

    A group of them could drown it with just a drop of spittle.

    "Look, the tiger demon is on the street, it's more than three meters tall!"

    Looking down from the management office, one can see a black tiger monster moving around on the street, killing everyone.

    The several bloody figures surrounding it all exuded powerful auras, but they could hardly cause any real damage to the black tiger.

    Instead, they were all shot away by the tiger demon.

    "Both are in the late stage of body-building, is the difference so big?"

    Shen Yun was also puzzled when he saw a battle between humans and demons for the first time.

    This was different from the tiger demon siege he imagined. There were almost no enemies in Yihe.

    "In the late stage of body nourishment, when all the energy and blood have escaped from the body, and the skills have not been fully practiced, how can one exert his strongest strength?"

    "Who are the truly capable monks who live in Lingnongfang or Linhuangfang on the edge? They are all casual cultivators like us who have no hope of joining the sect!"

    "Look at that black tiger. Bloody lines appear on its body as it swoops and sweeps. There is no energy and blood escaping..."

    There are so many people around, and there are many explanations from those who understand.

    Shen Yun suddenly realized that it turned out that in the later stage of body recuperation, when the blood energy escaped, he looked very powerful on the outside, but in fact it was because he had not mastered the martial arts!

    He thought that Qi and blood penetrated his body, just like a bloody dragon. He thought it was a symbol of power.

    "Give in..."

    There was sudden noise from behind, and several outer disciples were evacuating the crowd.

    "Senior Brother Luo is coming out, get out of the way and let Senior Brother Luo take action!"
title_en: Chapter 26 The gap between casual cultivators and sect disciples!
